polityNote: Colony of Jamaica (crown colony from 1866) to 1962-08-06, then independent Jamaica. The fourteen parishes of Law 20 of 1867 (in force 1867-05-01) are today's fourteen parishes; the three counties (Cornwall, Middlesex, Surrey) are judicial groupings, not administrative units, and are not drawn. The 22 parishes before 1867 are not unions of today's parishes (the Manchioneal district and parts of St Andrew/Port Royal were split), so the scope starts on 1867-05-01. ① independent check (2026-10-06): NE atom areas against statoids published parish areas, total 11,066 vs 11,191 km2 (0.99); per parish 0.92-1.12 (Kingston 30 vs 22 km2, coast generalisation).
